label: War Machine
description: Combat-weight machines built for the clash templates — every item carries mass, motion and battle state.

items.name: assault-mech
items.text: a twelve-meter bipedal assault mech mid-stride, torso twisting independent of the hips, autocannon barrels still smoking, fresh scoring raked across the glacis plate

items.name: siege-quadruped
items.text: a siege quadruped the size of a building, four column legs planted wide, the dorsal railgun spine charging with a rising line of light

items.name: hover-tank
items.text: a skirted hover tank drifting sideways over rubble, dust blasting out from under the plenum skirt, turret counter-rotating to hold its lock

items.name: duelist-frame
items.text: a sleek humanoid combat frame in a fencing stance, thermal blade shedding white droplets of molten edge, armor panels flared open for heat dump

items.name: artillery-crawler
items.text: a tracked artillery crawler in firing configuration, outriggers punched into the ground, twin barrels recoiling in staggered rhythm under climbing smoke rings

items.name: drone-carrier-gunship
items.text: a drone-carrier gunship on station, launch cells cycling along its flanks, attack drones peeling off in ribbons toward the ground

items.name: riot-enforcer
items.text: a squat riot-control enforcer braced behind a deployed ballistic shield wall, stun lattice crackling between its shoulder emitters

items.name: scrap-titan
items.text: a salvage titan welded from three generations of dead machines, mismatched arms, a crane for a spine, engine hearts glowing through gaps in the plating

items.name: spider-breacher
items.text: a spider-legged breaching platform climbing a wall face, cutting-torch mandibles throwing fans of sparks, anchor bolts firing into the concrete as it ascends

items.name: shield-bearer
items.text: a broad-shouldered guardian mech kneeling behind a projected energy aegis, hexagonal shield cells flaring white where impacts land, servos trembling under the sustained load

items.name: hunter-pack
items.text: a pack of low quadruped hunter drones moving in bounding overwatch, lidar eyes sweeping in synchronized arcs, dust kicked up in short bursts at every leap

items.name: wrecking-ram
items.text: a demolition ram-walker shouldering through a facade, counterweight haunches low, its tusk blade buried to the hilt in structural concrete as the floor above sags
